finding: A model transport failure racing with a memory or Skill source change could be reported as model unavailable without rechecking the withdrawn source.
fix: Recheck implicit decision memory when a model request throws; preserve the transport error only while the memory fingerprint is unchanged.
On other model failures, revalidate the saved Skill, memory and knowledge context before selecting a model failure response.
remaining: Run a bounded real account task with a source revoked during generation, then inspect durable task and tool receipts.
Confirm old checkpoint recovery and pre-tool refusal on the currently loaded service without adding an external effect.
The current branch contains other undeployed changes; source-only unit results cannot establish that production loaded this patch.
